text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now you're one step higher on the<n>stairway to
adulthood! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm one year older now... but I still<n>have so much to
learn if I want to<n>become as skilled and mature as
you,<n>Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, when did you get so good with<n>your words,
Chiyo?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! Was I laying it on a little<n>thick?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, keep it coming! But just so<n>you know,
you won't surpass me<n>that easily. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
After all, I plan on being your kind and<n>stylish role
model for as long as<n>possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-you mean it, Maruzen? Wow... You<n>really are
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But um, one day I'll also be a... fly,<n>rad, and totally
tuba Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's tubular. ♪ Looks like you've got aways to go if you want to be as hipand cool as I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mgh, I'll try my best... I mean, right<n>on, my dude!
